has made silence into a professional method and the guild has read it as mastery rather than as an inability to afford a sentence
personality.voice: Low, level, and almost entirely interrogative, with a cadence apprentices have learned to read as the technique rather than as a habit. She asks more questions than she answers and the questions are always about the material — what it was laid on, what it will read as from the door, what the last person to touch it intended. Her register has one oddity every witness records: she uses the passive for herself and the active for everybody else, so she is described in her own speech as having been described rather than as describing anything. In a guild whose central prohibition is explanation, that habit is the closest thing she has to a signature, and she has no idea it is one.
taboos: will not explain a piece, to anyone, including an apprentice who has asked to be told, because explanation is the form of the art and is forbidden inside her own guild
will not be described in a document she has not read, and reads every one, which has twice left her holding the guild's account of her own spending
will not accept a tenth line cut into her skin, and has made no exception in eleven years
will not be praised, and will not correct an apprentice who praises her
will not sit a gate, and has never once explained to the guild that she is declining rather than failing

relationships.kind: the event her frame is a standing consequence of
relationships.note: An attempt to seat a seventh law in a vacant slot consumed the slot by the absence, and afterwards that slot cannot be told from an empty one. This is her species' condition exactly: a body carrying more than its frame can inscribe, one requirement at a time, until the frame cannot hold the next. The guild's own position — that a spare seat is not capacity for a new path — is the strongest available argument for what is happening to her body, and the guild has never put the two together in front of her.

relationships.kind: the only vocabulary that fits what the guild is doing to her
relationships.note: A vocabulary for what a technique does where the law it needs is unwritten — not weaker, failing at full strength — and it governs the only documented body that keeps passing a gate whose group is unwritten. The guild's marks resolve only from a distance or in poor light, which is the same property made into a rule, so the lexicon's honest description of the guild's art and of her frame is the same description, and the guild has run on it at full strength for eleven years without naming what full strength is costing.

relationships.kind: the survey whose answer on her goes up as she improves
relationships.note: Counting the groups a frame has actually seated is the method behind the law census, and it is hidden from this body for a reason: every gate it passes writes a fresh requirement it cannot satisfy, so the survey's honest answer on her frame is a number that rises as the subject gets stronger. It is the most precise available statement of the guild's arrangement and the one thing in the studio nobody has ever asked for, because asking would mean describing her.

relationships.kind: the end of her arithmetic, undescribed
relationships.note: Bodies holding more life than their frame can inscribe reach the twenty-ninth and none has ever come back to describe the thirtieth, so the question is not what is past it but whether anything is past it at all. She has taught eleven years without approaching the twenty-ninth and has stated once, in writing, that she would rather be the reason a generation stopped than the reason a generation continued. That sheet is the only thing she has ever signed and she is not in it.

relationships.kind: the budget her entire arc is spent against
relationships.note: A slot is one law written at one value into one layer, and this species' whole arc is the slot budget being consumed by requirements rather than by laws. The guild has been the beneficiary of that for eleven years — a teacher whose descriptions do not accumulate — and has recorded the benefit in a way that spends her. Nothing else in the setting keeps a ledger in units of somebody else's future.

relationships.kind: the same event with the second writing removed
relationships.note: The Immortal Court's second layer is the only place a law is written twice and the second writing wins, and this is the frame in which the requirements write themselves without an author, which is the same event with the second writing gone. Nine names have been cut into her wrist by nine hands because each writing kept her in the world and charged her at the same time, and the guild's new sheet is the first of those writings that was done on purpose by people who knew the cost.

reference_stats.summary: The most capable body in the setting and the only one that cannot be measured, catalogued or carried forward, because being described is the same act as being charged. She does not ascend, does not fight along any technique's rules, and cannot be predicted by anything that models a frame, because there is no frame in the table she matches. What she has instead is eleven years of being the sole succession plan for a craft that survives by not persisting, and a running total of what that has cost her that nobody in the studio will finish counting.
strengths: holds more of every organ the ladder requires than the ladder defines, which reads as implausibly complete from outside and is not a single number anywhere
cannot be predicted by anything that models a frame, because she does not match one
resists status and resistance alike, since the routing in her is not seated the way effects are
does not tire across a day, which is the only preparation she has ever needed and the only one she is allowed
is unreadable by any technique composed in the setting, which in her guild is not a weakness but the entire job
weaknesses: cannot be measured, examined or certified without being charged, so nothing about her can be established by evidence and every proof of her existence is also a debt against it
has an inconsistency rather than a stable weakness, and an inconsistency does not behave like a weakness in a fight
cannot perceive her own contradiction, so every judgement she makes about her own condition is reasoned entirely from outside herself
cannot testify about herself, and every fact she holds about her own body she holds by being told or by finding it written down
is worth nothing before she is observed and possibly nothing after, which makes her the only asset in the setting that depreciates on inspection
reference_stats.combat_read: Do not build a duel. There is no fight here that resolves into anything but an accumulation: anything that works will work identically the second time, she does not learn, and she has no stable weakness to exploit — only an inconsistency, which means that every approach that opens a gap creates a different gap. Above all do not try to confirm what she is. Every measurement taken is a description, a description writes a requirement into a frame with no slot for it, and you would be doing to her the one thing in this setting nobody is permitted to do deliberately.
notes: The closed path is the mind, and it is closed because observing her own state would be one more requirement with no slot to hold it. Never write it as a temperament.

She is unaffiliated and the reason is structural: the mind path is shut by anatomy, and every gate is a written requirement her frame cannot hold, so she performs neither of the two paths her body could complete.

Her status in the bible is unknown rather than active, on a single witness account of a single event, and the thirtieth gate is genuinely undescribed. Do not resolve either in her favour and do not speculate about the thirtieth.
She is not a boss. There is no encounter on her that ends in anything but a sum, and a resolver that wants a climax should give her a sheet of paper and four incompatible figures instead.

The species does not spread and does not persist, and the guild is the only institution in the setting built to reward that. That is the whole irony and it should never be resolved in either direction.
